CREATE TABLE "public"."Activity" (
  "authorId" text,
  "companyId" text,
  "contactId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text,
  "opportunityId" text,
  "projectId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Completed' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Attachment" (
  "companyId" text,
  "contactId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "fileUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text,
  "mimeType" text,
  "opportunityId" text,
  "provider" text DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL,
  "size" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Client" (
  "companyId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Company" (
  "companySize" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "industry" text,
  "location" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "source" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Prospect',
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Contact" (
  "companyId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobTitle" text,
  "linkedin" text,
  "location" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "whatsapp" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."FollowUp" (
  "companyId" text,
  "contactId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text,
  "notes" text,
  "opportunityId" text,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'Normal' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Pending' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Invoice" (
  "clientId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "issueDate" timestamptz,
  "projectId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Draft' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "tax" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "total" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."InvoiceItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "total" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Lead" (
  "assignedUserId" text,
  "companyId" text,
  "companyName" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "estimatedBudget" float8,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "industry" text,
  "leadScore" int4,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nextFollowUp" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "pipelineStage" text,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'Normal',
  "serviceInterestedIn" text,
  "source" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'New' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Opportunity" (
  "companyId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estimatedValue" float8,
  "expectedCloseDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lossReason" text,
  "nextFollowUp" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "primaryContactId" text,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'Normal',
  "probability" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  "service" text,
  "source" text,
  "stage" text DEFAULT 'New' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Payment" (
  "amount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text,
  "notes" text,
  "reference" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Project" (
  "budget" float8,
  "clientId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "expectedCompletion" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'Normal',
  "startDate" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Planning' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Proposal" (
  "clientId" text,
  "companyId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "discount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "opportunityId" text,
  "proposalNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Draft' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "tax" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "total" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validUntil" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProposalItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "discount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "proposalId" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "service" text NOT NULL,
  "total" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Tag" (
  "color" text DEFAULT '#6b7280' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Task" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'Normal',
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Todo' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'ADMIN' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
